insights.insight: The protocol has generated 12,411 cryptographically confirmed purchase receipts totaling $996,004 in verified GMV — deterministic proof of transaction, not probabilistic inference. For brands paying $5+ CPM for cookie-based targeting, this represents a fundamentally different data class: the purchase already happened.

At $3,996 remaining and a single heartbeat adding $2,055, the $1M cumulative GMV crossing is arithmetic — not speculative. The milestone marks the first meaningful proof-of-scale checkpoint for a verified commerce data network operating across physical retail, dining, fuel, warehouse, and SaaS categories.

insights.topic: Velocity deceleration with early stabilization signal
insights.insight: Token velocity fell from a peak of 1.241x on April 12 to a trough of 0.819x on April 17T05:40 — the sharpest single-cycle drop recorded — before recovering to 0.855x with acceleration climbing to 1.013x. One data point does not confirm a floor; the next heartbeat is the confirmation test.

insights.topic: Geographic diffusion pattern: pulse, not linear
insights.insight: Three consecutive 7-CBSA expansion pulses have occurred across April 15–17, following a 14-CBSA single-heartbeat record on April 13. The network does not grow continuously — it surges, consolidates, then surges again, which has direct implications for how brands should model regional audience availability.

insights.topic: Category breadth now includes SaaS subscriptions
insights.insight: SaaS subscription receipts entered the network on April 9 — the first non-physical-commerce category in the protocol's history. For CMOs, this signals the data layer is no longer limited to in-store or dining purchase verification; digital subscription behavior is now in scope.

A complete endpoint blackout on April 14 — all 16 endpoints offline simultaneously — resolved within roughly 12 hours, with the network resuming across 15 metros and adding 3 new CBSAs post-recovery. For marketers evaluating this as a data dependency, the blackout is a documented risk event; the recovery speed is the counterweight.
